text:
Recent work distinguishes convincing explanations, evidence support, and faithfulness to the recommender. [ALERT (NAACL 2025)](https://aclanthology.org/2025.naacl-long.137/) uses structured annotation questions but reports Krippendorff’s α=0.24, showing substantial disagreement. [Human Feedback Is Not Gold Standard (ICLR 2024)](https://proceedings.iclr.cc/paper_files/paper/2024/hash/f719b8ca81221f380836e573d479c223-Abstract-Conference.html) finds that preferences underrepresent factuality and assertive wording biases judgments. [Walk the Talk (ICLR 2025)](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/research/publication/walk-the-talk-measuring-the-faithfulness-of-large-language-model-explanations/) evaluates faithfulness through counterfactual interventions; evidence-linked explanations alone cannot establish model causality.

A suitable adaptation: annotate each complaint with user/item IDs, exact title/description spans, and relevant history timestamps. Separate explicit attribute mismatch, documented functional overlap, unsupported compatibility claims, and insufficient information. Functional overlap does not establish unnecessary duplication; historical interaction does not establish ownership or unmet need. Compatibility requires explicit specifications; timestamps establish recency, not present intent. Permit supported, contradicted, and unknown judgments. [AMBIFC (2024)](https://aclweb.org/anthology/2024.tacl-1.1.pdf) supports evidence-level annotation and explicit uncertainty; [abstention experiments (EMNLP 2024)](https://aclanthology.org/2024.findings-emnlp.197/) show that models often answer despite inadequate context.

Proposed diagnostic protocol: independently double-annotate the prescribed twenty users, five/category, with model identities blinded. Calibrate the rubric, freeze it, then report pre-adjudication agreement, per-label counts, unknown rates, and evidence coverage; retain disagreement records. Compare preregistered single-model NextItNet changes on matched users using user-level uncertainty estimates. Treat this small panel as exploratory diagnostic evidence. Selection remains unchanged macro validation HR@10; neither agreement nor fewer annotated failures establishes ranking improvement or generalizable user benefit.
